native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'initial', 'state': {'bargraph1': 'all off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, all LEDs on the bar graph should be off.'}

test2: {'time': 'after moving potentiometer to 0.2', 'state': {'bargraph1': 'first LED off'}, 'description': 'Potentiometer interaction phase. After moving the potentiometer to a low value (0.2), the first LED (pin A10) should remain off, indicating that only a few or no LEDs are lit.'}

test3: {'time': 'after pressing button', 'state': {'bargraph1': 'last LED off'}, 'description': 'Button interaction phase. After pressing the button, the order of lighting should reverse. The last LED (pin A1) should be off, confirming the reversed lighting order.'}

test4: {'time': 'after moving potentiometer to 1', 'state': {'bargraph1': 'all on'}, 'description': 'Full potentiometer range phase. After moving the potentiometer to its maximum value (1), all LEDs on the bar graph should be lit, regardless of the lighting order.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
test_origin: manual_requirement_derived_supplement; retained original test plan is unchanged
